annotations.text:
The journey these pages serve:
Google search ("Tai Po Rhenish Church Kindergarten fees") → school page answers instantly → "View on the map" deep-links into the existing map app with that school selected.

The map app is untouched — these are ~1,000 static entry doors generated at build time from the same snapshot.

Invisible on the wireframe but part of every page:
• unique <title> + meta description (name, fees, district, year)
• JSON-LD schema.org Preschool (address, geo, phone)
• breadcrumb structured data
• OpenGraph share card
• entry in sitemap.xml
Deliberate: school pages load NO map engine (the 350KB MapLibre stays in the app only). The locator is a static image — pages stay fast, which is itself a ranking factor.
